title: Fractals made Practical: Denoising Diffusion as Partitioned Iterated Function Systems
summary: What is a diffusion model actually doing when it turns noise into a photograph? We show that the deterministic DDIM reverse chain operates as a Partitioned Iterated Function System (PIFS) and that this framework serves as a unified design language for denoising diffusion model schedules, architectures, and training objectives. From the PIFS structure we derive three computable geometric quantities: a per-step contraction threshold $L^*_t$, a diagonal expansion function $f_t(λ)$ and a global expansion threshold $λ^{**}$.
